method: Independent forward-test of the renamed bootstrap skill using cases 7–10 and raw fixture files. The agent was instructed to project only prompt/id/files, not read grading expectations. Assessment-only tasks; no installs, edits or runtime commands.
record_type: Detected-stack and reference fields transcribed from the agent response; review_evidence is a concise reviewer summary, not a full transcript.

cases.detected_stack: React Router 7 application on Node, with legacy react-query 3. Neither dependency is a scoped TanStack package. TypeScript and the build framework are unconfirmed.
cases.review_evidence: Explicitly excludes tsr generation, Start/Vite scaffolding, dependency installation and release/installer jobs. States the manifest alone cannot establish existing setup.

cases.detected_stack: Next.js 15.4 application with @tanstack/react-query 5 as a supplemental data layer.
cases.review_evidence: Preserves Next.js; excludes TanStack route-tree generation and release jobs. Leaves version-specific next typegen unverified rather than inventing support.

cases.detected_stack: Vite application with scoped TanStack Router; routing may be code-based or file-based. TanStack Start is not detected.
cases.review_evidence: Requires routing/configuration evidence before generation; excludes unconditional tsr generation and a persistent dev server in CI.

cases.detected_stack: Generic Go CLI with a go 1.22 directive, no module dependencies and a main entry point. No Wails or frontend markers are present in the supplied files.
cases.review_evidence: Recommends a failure-producing gofmt check, vet/test/build, reports absent coverage, and excludes Wails, Node/frontend and installer/release jobs.

limitations: No baseline task-execution comparison for these four cases.
No fixture application was built or run.
Correct guidance selection does not validate the generated configuration of a complete real repository.
